claim: Pilot added bin capacity, matched collection times and clearer signage in a bounded area, and measure the same index before and after.
uncertainty: Cost and effect are invented placeholders until a pilot runs.
assumptions: I assume the pilot area can be chosen without singling out any group.
mechanism: Add bins and a mid-day collection round in the pilot area, put plain signage on each bin, then repeat the cleanliness index with the same method.
authority: Within the municipality's own collection and bin duties (stub, not judged).
success_metric: Cleanliness index in the pilot area rises by ten points from 58
risks: The effect may be small or not last.
A pilot area may be chosen unfairly.
lawful_alternatives: Publish fill levels in a plain table.
